req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-020 requires GET /docs to serve interactive Swagger UI with HTTP 2xx. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — nominal GET /docs returns 200 with HTML content containing Swagger UI markers; (2) negative NEG — wrong method POST /docs returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — response Content-Type is exactly text/html and body contains the exact FastAPI app title string used to configure Swagger UI, catching mutations to the title or content-type header. Each test uses TestClient in-process, asserts exact status codes and exact content markers to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_get_returns_200_with_html_body
preconditions: FastAPI app is initialised with title 'Task Manager API'
Swagger UI is enabled at /docs (default FastAPI behaviour)
expected: Response body contains the string 'swagger' (case-insensitive marker)
Response body contains the app title 'Task Manager API'
trace: R-TASK-020: system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs
Expected outcome: HTTP 2xx response with expected payload
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=True)

def test_swagger_ui_get_returns_200_with_html_body():
    r = client.get("/docs")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    content_type = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert "text/html" in content_type
    body = r.text
    assert "swagger" in body.lower()
    assert "Task Manager API" in body

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_post_returns_405
preconditions: POST method is not registered for /docs
expected: HTTP status code is exactly 405 (Method Not Allowed)
trace: R-TASK-020: error pathway — HTTP 4xx on client error
POST to a GET-only endpoint must yield 405, not 200 or 5xx
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_swagger_ui_post_returns_405():
    r = client.post("/docs")
    assert r.status_code == 405
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 500

Response body length is greater than 0
trace: R-TASK-020: expected payload must include Swagger UI referencing the correct OpenAPI spec URL and app title
BVA: boundary between a valid Swagger page and a blank/error page — body must be non-empty and contain exact markers
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=True)

def test_swagger_ui_response_contains_exact_openapi_url_and_title():
    r = client.get("/docs")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.text
    assert len(body) > 0
    assert "openapi.json" in body
    assert "Task Manager API" in body
    assert "1.0.0" in body
